name: YITA-65P-C
summary: An integrated robot joint module in YITA Dynamics’ C series, combining precision transmission, drive control and dual absolute-encoder feedback. This model has a 7.8 N·m rated torque, 39 N·m peak torque and 0.5 kg mass. It supports EtherCAT and CAN FD and includes a through-bore for routing.
